rows.name:
A Homs settlement located on the lower leg of[XENO:n ]
the Giant God. Often suffers from falling debris.

A cave located in the shin of the Giant God. Famous[XENO:n ]
as a historical site containing ancient artefacts.

A vast plain connecting the colonies.[XENO:n ]
Its lush landscape is teeming with wildlife.

Originally an ether mining settlement, little[XENO:n ]
remains after a devastating Mechon attack.

A focal point of the Giant God's ether energy. It has[XENO:n ]
long been exploited as a supply of minerals.

Mysterious marshland scattered with High Entia[XENO:n ]
ruins. At night, it is bathed in an eerie glow.

Humid sub-tropical forest. The ecosystem allows[XENO:n ]
for creatures larger than those found elsewhere.

A giant tree inhabited by the Nopon. It is a haven[XENO:n ]
of peace, far from the chaos of the world.

Ancient sanctum where the crown prince seeks[XENO:n ]
approval from the Forefathers who slumber within.

A great sea located on the head of the Giant God.[XENO:n ]
Floating islands are connected by transporters.

The High Entia's floating city. It boasts technology[XENO:n ]
far beyond anything the Homs could imagine.

A prison said to have been sealed by the High[XENO:n ]
Entia Forefathers. Its history remains a mystery.

The prison that once held Zanza. It fell from the[XENO:n ]
sky into the interior of the Giant God.

Treacherous and snowy terrain. After nightfall[XENO:n ]
the area looks entirely different.

The great sword of the Machine God pierces the[XENO:n ]
Giant God. A place where Homs and Mechon clash.

Fortress stronghold on Machine God. Torrents of[XENO:n ]
Giant God Ether flow inward via the great sword.

Arm of the Machine God, severed by the Giant God in[XENO:n ]
the Great Battle. Rust now covers the arm.

Systems supporting the body of the Machine God are[XENO:n ]
located here. Numerous lifts travel up and down.

Once prosperous capital of the Machina. It is the[XENO:n ]
site of a shrine dedicated to Meyneth.

Area where the Mechon are manufactured and[XENO:n ]
also where captured Homs are taken.

An area rich in organic components. Here, one[XENO:n ]
can truly feel that the Giant God is also a living being.

A mysterious space etched with memories[XENO:n ]
ever since the Giant God came into existence.

Heart of the systems that control the Machine God.[XENO:n ]
A large panoramic screen serves as its eye.

Flying machine created using Mechon technology.[XENO:n ]
It also serves as the Machina control centre.

Suspended in air by Hover Stone after the Giant God's
fall, the Giants' birthplace still houses many ruins.

The former capital of the High Entia. Lonely and
desolate, its old grandeur is long gone.
